decisions.reason: The contractual F1 quote establishes only the fixed-machine O_M theorem, not the buffer construction imported by the proof. The actual published supplier Proof does contain the representation (3.1), redistribution (4.1), fixed-tape scans (4.2 and 6.2), event count (6.1 and 7.1), and lazy initialization (8.1); it does not state these as an exported claim, and Proof is not an admissible contract source_section. The repaired lemma removes that dependency and proves the exact redistribution and stack invariant locally, then bounds scans and reset counts explicitly in L. The Statement and both access profiles are unchanged.

The original compilation replaces a source unitary by successive factors without testing whether the source operation is omitted on coincident heads. For example, H tensor F on coincident heads is omitted, whereas its one-qubit factors need not be identity. The repaired proof first computes the exact work-head equality partition using one-hot classical marker tracks and fresh copied erased index streams. It skips every factor of an omitted unitary, keeps native quantum query blocks contiguous, and proves constant guard overhead and O(s+1) marker extent. Thus the subsequent finite-precision error and paired-path count arguments apply to the actual source semantics.

reviews.reason: The local centre/two-stack construction now proves exact ordered redistribution and complementary occupancies in step 4.1. Step 5.1 bounds each field scan by polynomial(L) times 2^i; step 5.2 proves at most floor(b/2^i) events including the first, and step 6.1 initializes only untouched input suffixes. The designated fair-bit construction preserves every terminal-prefix mass. For erased indexes, fresh word length totals polynomial(L)b, cached neighboring blocks suffice because B>b, and literal tries use charged short physical addresses. Halt-before-expiry includes b=0 and the last allowed transition. No source-space preservation or AC is used. The canonical precheck reorder was adopted and then precheck passed. The owning contract and manifest dependency are synchronized. Focused precheck, rendercheck, strict contract and final batched proof-layout checks all pass.

Step 1.1 now proves an exact marker invariant and collision-omission guard with fixed heads, fresh index duplication, clamped zero motion, and constant-stride O(s+1) work extent. Step 2.1 compiles only admitted transitions on stationary distinct quantum operands; the source classical symbol tuple is preserved before sequential writes. Omitted blocks have zero error, so history-wise projective rephasing, the 1/20 vector error and 1/10 probability bound remain valid in step 3.1. Steps 3.2-6.1 retain the exact phase-pair count identity, native contiguous basis queries, disagreement counter, denominator padding and strict-majority sign construction within the original claimed resources. The canonical precheck reorder was adopted and then precheck passed. This is a repair-author check, not independent review. The owning contract is synchronized. Focused precheck, rendercheck, strict contract and final batched proof-layout checks all pass.
